Based on the image provided, here is the exact state of the screen:

*   **Message Composer:** Yes, there is a message composer at the bottom of the main area. It contains **no typed text**. The placeholder text reads: "Ask Codex to change, inspect, or explain...".
*   **Slash-command Dropdown:** No, a slash-command dropdown is not visible.
*   **Modal/Notification:** There is a small notification banner (toast) open at the bottom right, just above the bottom edge of the window. It displays the text: "**Connection lost. Reconnecting...**" with a "**Dismiss**" button on its right side.

**Additional Context:**
The main screen shows "What should we work on?" and indicates "No chats". In the left sidebar, under "Projects", an item named "**fixture**" is selected (highlighted in light blue). At the very bottom left, there is a status message: "⚠️ Retry 4 in 8s".
